Context: 29. Postaf Tariff and Savi:ngs Schemes

| Post Office Monthly Income Scheme Account (MIS) | 7.4 % per annum payable monthly. | In multiples of INR ~ 1,000. Maximum investment limit is INR ~ 9 lakh in single account and INR ~ 15 lakh in joint account. | |
| Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS) | 8.2 % per annum | In multiples of INR ~ 1,000 maximum not exceeding INR ~ 30 lakh. | Investment under this scheme qualifies for the benefit of Section 80-C of the IT Act from 1-4-2007. |
